detail.summary: Realized I would have to use the scientific method to convince people that we are being managed beyond our current perception of reality
detail.description:
Premise:
Exercising the scientific method begins with a philosophical argument.
There is no such thing as coincidence, and there is enough data to prove it.
The next generation of students can be trained to act perfectly logically towards a predetermined outcome.
Success can be qualified by categorizing by asking CEOs what has led them to success?
Every answer can be measured, tested, and duplicated.
I can relate multiple experiences from my own life to satisfy every category of success.
